thread:
alex: Quick async — kernel slot allocator fair-share patch landed. Running microbench tomorrow against v2 scheduler. Observed tail p99 spike when slot stealers > 3, suspect contention on runqueue. Will instrument.

mira: Nice. Can you dump a heap+contention profile? I can mirror the run locally. Also ping for a CR.

alex: Yep — sample command:
```
./bench/run_bench --target=v2 --concurrency=8 --out=profile.pb
```
I'll upload results to the bench bucket.

sam: I can spin up the canary bench in us-west, want me to run the same flags + `--kv-warmup=full`?

alex: Please — include `--kv-warmup=full` and `--slot-timeout=120ms` so we reproduce. thx :pray: 

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: canary-2026-03-18-04. Will post results to #eng-runtime-bench after completion.

jordan: Heads up — I'm iterating on kv eviction thresholds in the same timeframe. If the canary uses full warmup, it might mask evictions. Recommend another run without warmup to validate steady-state.

alex: Good call. We'll run two passes (warmup + steady). CR ping: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/482 — brief review appreciated. small unit-test flake in CI blocking merge.

mira: I'll take the CR and look at the flake; can reproduce locally. ETA ~2h.

sam: I'll queue the two bench runs once mira thumbs up on the PR. Leave a note here when done. :thumbsup: 

alex: Awesome — blockers: test flake + need the second steady-state run. Today: triage flake, collect microbench artifacts, and coordinate canary runs.
